human_requirements: The human types the public access code at test time; it is never stored or logged by QA.
Chat on the public URL spends the personal provider key: authorize real-model turns explicitly.
Warm the service (GET /api/health) before timed checks; Render Events/Logs are only visible to the human.
surfaces.notes: Smoke it with the preflight-cli surface pointed at this URL (human types PREFLIGHT_ACCESS_CODE). The service must run with FECHA_EJECUCION=2026-09-03 or preflight fails before the access check.

surfaces.name: preflight-cli

start.qa_override: PREFLIGHT_ACCESS_CODE=<synthetic, same as the target's ACCESS_CODE> bun --no-env-file src/cli/runners/preflight.runner.ts --url http://localhost:<port> (inline, never written to a file), against a local target started as: NODE_ENV=development PORT=<free port> FECHA_EJECUCION=2026-09-03 ACCESS_CODE=<synthetic> LLM_API_KEY=<fake> bun --no-env-file src/server.ts

required: PREFLIGHT_ACCESS_CODE (env only, never a CLI argument; same length rules as ACCESS_CODE)
PREFLIGHT_URL | --url (one of; bare origin, https or http only on localhost/127.0.0.1/[::1]; an empty --url does not override PREFLIGHT_URL)

probe.detail: local target only (synthetic code, fake key, torn down): exit 0 in <1 s -> health 200 (llm disponible), /api/config accepted, fecha 2026-09-03, 4 casos; 0 LLM calls. Also verified: target with FECHA_EJECUCION != 2026-09-03 -> exit 1 'revisa FECHA_EJECUCION'; wrong code -> exit 1 on the first 401 without retrying; missing code -> exit 1 naming PREFLIGHT_ACCESS_CODE; missing URL -> exit 1; http on a non-loopback host -> rejected before any request. Works both via bun run (local env file) and with --no-env-file.

human_requirements: Against the public deploy URL the human supplies PREFLIGHT_ACCESS_CODE at run time; QA never stores, logs or passes it. One wrong code is one failed attempt toward the IP lockout (ACCESS_MAX_FAILED_ATTEMPTS), so never loop it.
surfaces.notes: Default mode spends no LLM tokens (health + access + config only). Readiness waits up to 180 s for a cold Render start (PLAZO_DESPERTAR_MS). Exit code is 1 on any failure, including usage errors.
